name: Joushi no Tsuma wa, Motokano Deshita ~Iyagari nagara mo, Makura Eigyou ni Oborete Iku After 5~
original_name: 上司の妻は、元カノでした ～嫌がりながらも、枕営業に溺れていくアフター5～
source: Tomoki faces new troubles in the office. After the old boss steps down along with their financial manager, the new leader of the company hires his wife Shiho to manage the finances and employees. Shiho – his old ex-girlfriend – takes to her job with authority, cracking down on lenient policies and causing stress for everyone in the office when Tomoki uncovers his old sex-tapes capturing her in the act with him. With that evidence in hand, he begins solving the office tensions by reminding her how good sex can feel with her sensitive body.
translation: 智树在办公室面临新的麻烦。老老板和财务经理下台后，公司的新领导聘请了他的妻子志保来管理财务和员工。他的前女友志穗以权威的态度对待她的工作，严厉打击宽松的政策，当智树发现他的旧性爱录像带时，他给办公室里的每个人带来了压力。有了这些证据，他开始通过提醒她敏感的身体如何享受性爱来解决办公室的紧张气氛。
